input.summary: Collect useful lit 1–9 numbers at the center target, redirect repeats into SPECIAL lanes, then collect the safest center, saucer, or return-lane award.

quickInfo.name: Center target
quickInfo.summary: The center standup collects the currently lit number from the 1-9 grid.

quickInfo.name: Number change
quickInfo.summary: Each 100-point switch changes which 1-9 number is lit for the center target.

quickInfo.name: Number patterns
quickInfo.summary: Three numbers in a row or all four corners light the center target and both side saucers for major awards.

quickInfo.name: SPECIAL letters
quickInfo.summary: Complete the S-P-E-C-I-A-L lanes to light both return lanes for major awards.

quickInfo.name: Edition scoring
quickInfo.summary: Tropic Fun uses ten-times Gulfstream scoring and replaces replay-focused awards with add-a-ball behavior.

steps.text: Read the lit number below the center target before each controlled shot.
If the number extends a row or adds a missing corner, shoot the center target.
If the lit number is already collected, shoot a safe lettered lane instead.
Use 100-point switch play to move the lit number. Read the new number before another center shot.
After three in a row or all four corners, collect a lit center-target or side-saucer award.
modeNotes: Number pattern: Gulfstream lights the center target and both saucers for 5,000. Tropic Fun awards 50,000 for a line and 100,000 for four corners.

steps.text: Complete S-P-E-C-I-A-L through the lettered lanes.
Collect a lit return lane when its feed is safer than another center-target rebound.

fallback.title: SPECIAL lane route
fallback.when: Use this when the lit number repeats or center-target rebounds are not controlled.

steps.text: Identify a missing S-P-E-C-I-A-L letter.
Shoot the safer lettered lane.
Complete all seven letters to light both return lanes.
Collect the safer lit return lane.

alternatives.title: Number-pattern route
alternatives.when: Use this when the center target returns safely and the lit number advances a row or the four corners.

steps.text: Choose a three-number row or the four corner pattern.
Use 100-point switches until an uncollected pattern number lights.
Shoot the center target to collect that number.
After the pattern is complete, collect the safest lit major award.
Collect three numbers in a row or all four corners.
Complete three numbers in a row or all four corners to light the center target and both side saucers.
Complete all seven S-P-E-C-I-A-L letters.
Collect the safest lit major award from each completed system.

techniques.name: Lit-number selection
techniques.instruction: Read the lit 1-9 number before the center shot. Shoot only when that number extends your chosen pattern.

techniques.name: Duplicate-number redirect
techniques.instruction: When the lit number is already collected, send the ball through the A or L lane instead of the center target.

cautions.issue: The center standup has rebound risk, but it is the only shot that collects the lit 1-9 number.
cautions.response: Shoot it only for useful pattern progress. Use the letter route when the number repeats.

cautions.issue: Bumper exits can reach the slingshots, center drain, or outlanes without flipper control.
cautions.response: Prepare both flippers before the ball leaves the bumpers. Stop forcing switch play after an unsafe exit.

cautions.issue: Gulfstream and Tropic Fun use different score scales and award handling.
cautions.response: Identify the edition before play. Do not apply Tropic Fun's ten-times values or add-a-ball rules to Gulfstream.

playfieldReferences.label: Lit-number target
playfieldReferences.description: Center standup used to collect the currently lit 1–9 number.

playfieldReferences.label: 1–9 number grid
playfieldReferences.description: Nine-number display used to track lines and corner patterns.

playfieldReferences.label: Side saucers
playfieldReferences.description: Two upper holes lit by completing a line or all four corners.

playfieldReferences.label: SPECIAL lanes
playfieldReferences.description: Seven lettered lanes used to light both return lanes.

playfieldReferences.label: Lit return lanes
playfieldReferences.description: Lower lanes lit for the major award after SPECIAL is complete.
